C21 and C24 are also very strong instances of the same template, but C03 is the closest overall textual match.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the President is authorized, under the conditions prescribed in that act, to grant an extension of time for the fulfillment of the conditions and formalities for the renewal of trade-mark registrations","parent_excerpt":"the President is authorized, under the conditions prescribed in that act, to grant an extension of time for the fulfillment of the conditions and formalities for the renewal of trade-mark registrations","explanation":"The statutory-authority recital is reproduced nearly verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"with respect to trade-marks of nationals of Belgium registered in the United States Patent Office which have been subject to renewal on or after September 3, 1939","parent_excerpt":"with respect to trade-marks of nationals of Luxembourg registered in the United States Patent Office which have been subject to renewal on or after September 3, 1939","explanation":"The operative finding uses the same wording with only the country changed."},{"child_excerpt":"because of conditions growing out of World War II, such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance with the conditions and formalities prescribed with respect to renewal","parent_excerpt":"because of conditions growing out of World War II, such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance with the conditions and formalities prescribed with respect to renewal","explanation":"This distinctive factual and legal predicate is identical."},{"child_excerpt":"Belgium accords substantially equal treatment in this respect to trademark proprietors who are citizens of the United States; and that accordingly the time within which compliance with conditions and formalities prescribed with respect to renewal of registrations ... may take place is hereby extended","parent_excerpt":"Luxembourg accords substantially equal treatment in this respect to trade-mark proprietors who are citizens of the United States; and that accordingly the time within which compliance with conditions and formalities prescribed with respect to renewal of registrations ... may take place is hereby extended","explanation":"The reciprocal-treatment finding and resulting extension mechanism are carried over almost word for word."}]}
